verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Rules, the product's own automation layer, support draft rules that run in shadow mode, plus performance reports and backtesting. That lets users review a rule change before it affects outcomes. Nothing in the evidence documents rule version history or rolling back to a prior rule version; API versioning covers dated API releases, not user automations. Missing for 10: explicit rule version history, a documented rollback/revert mechanism, a diff or approval workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: shadow mode lets draft rules observe the authorization stream without affecting outcomes, while performance reports and backtesting measure impact over time
